title: Clause 10 - Improvement
description: Working paper template for ISO/IEC 42001 Clause 10: nonconformity, corrective action, continual improvement.

sections.title: Nonconformity and corrective action (10.1)
prompts: Verify NC handling process: identification, root cause, action, effectiveness verification.
Confirm AI-incident classification distinguishes NCs from incidents.
Sample NCs and trace through to closure.

sections.title: Continual improvement (10.2)
prompts: Identify systemic improvements implemented in the period.
Verify trend analysis informs improvement priorities.

checklists.text: Sampled NCs have evidence of effectiveness verification.
AI-specific incidents trigger root cause analysis.

suggestedInterviewQuestions: Sample three closed NCs and walk us through the lifecycle.
How do AI-specific incidents feed your improvement programme?
What systemic improvement was made in the last 12 months and why?
